title: AI Psychosis Watch — dataset of reported AI-associated psychological harm
description:
A weekly-updated record of reported psychological harm associated with conversational AI systems: delusional reinforcement, distorted reality testing, identity confusion, paranoia and dependent attachment, alongside the clinical and research literature examining those phenomena.

Entries document reports rather than verified clinical diagnoses. Counts reflect media and research coverage, not population incidence. Full inclusion criteria, classification scheme and limitations are documented at aipsychosis.watch/methodology.html.
